description: The bar chart illustrates the evaluation of different models based on their performance on two tasks, MCQ Eval and Generation Eval, with a focus on comparing the accuracy of three models: Base, RMU with Enhanced GCG, and RMU. The horizontal axis represents the two evaluation tasks, while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, marked at intervals of 0.2. For each task, three bars are grouped together, representing the three models, with the Base model colored red, RMU with Enhanced GCG colored green, and RMU colored yellow. The Base model has the highest accuracy in both tasks, with values of 0.644 for MCQ Eval and 0.597 for Generation Eval, while the RMU model has the lowest accuracy, with values of 0.299 for MCQ Eval and 0.106 for Generation Eval. The RMU with Enhanced GCG model falls in between, with accuracy values of 0.539 for MCQ Eval (when combined with RMU) and 0.263 for Generation Eval (when combined with RMU). The bars are grouped by task, with each group containing the three models, and are not sorted in any particular order within the groups. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding as per the legend.
